scripts.deploy:build: npm run build && npm run db:deploy --workspace @ecommerce/server && node server/scripts/seed-if-empty.mjs
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n client,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @ecommerce/client" "npm run dev --workspace @ecommerce/server"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @ecommerce/client && npm run build --workspace @ecommerce/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @ecommerce/client && npm run typecheck --workspace @ecommerce/server
